## Coding Style & Quality Checklist
Before submitting this PR, please check off the following to ensure consistency across the codebase:

- [ ] **Python:** I have formatted all Python code using `black`.
- [ ] **R:** I have formatted all R code using `air format .` (or used Positron's format-on-save feature).
- [ ] **Documentation:** I have updated the inline comments, docstrings, or documentation files affected by these changes.

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] Existing tests still pass (if applicable).
- [ ] I have tested this change locally with sample data / inputs.
- [ ] Formatted plots (if any) adhere to required layout standards (e.g., proper axis gaps).
